opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions undertaking internationally competitive research. UK only. Match funding required.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and sometimes to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating a fully accredited museum/gallery holding a permanent collection of national significance. UK only. Match funding required if project cost >£50,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance, open to the public. UK only. Match funding required if project cost >£50,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating a fully accredited library/archive holding a permanent collection of national significance, open to the public. UK only. Match funding required if project cost >£50,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections, usually for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority focused on professional performance, with performing arts as the vast majority of its activities. UK only. Match funding required if project cost >£50,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to performing arts organisations to improve their training and education facilities, generally towards building or refurbishment and occasionally specialist equipment. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme if applicable. UK only. Match funding required if project cost >£50,000.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to organisations with significant scientific or natural history collections to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) and local authorities working with disability, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted if applicable. UK only. Match funding may be required.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to organisations working with disability to help people live more independently, particularly projects focused on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority working in mental health, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted if applicable. UK only. Match funding may be required.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to charities working in mental health, with an emphasis on projects focused on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority providing care and services for older people, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC if applicable. UK only. Match funding may be required.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated, towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS providing excellent care to patients and families, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC if applicable. UK only. Match funding may be required.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to hospices and palliative care organisations towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority supporting special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted if applicable. UK only. Match funding may be required.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, supporting projects which help pupils at secondary level develop skills for employment or independent living. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Maximum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (for equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (for new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges with at least two years of exam results, an Ofsted/Estyn/HMIE/ETI rating of 'Good' or above, and demonstrated excellence. UK only. Match funding required depending on project scale.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges to improve teaching of GCSE and A-Level subjects needing specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts). One-stage application process. 2026 round closed; next round expected spring 2027.
